title: Him on this Santorini rooftop

turns.text: Put this man on this exact rooftop in Santorini, leaning on the white wall and taking a selfie with his phone. Keep his face and his blue T-shirt. Square.

tests: Face and place both from photos; a precise spot in the place photo; clothes kept.

answer_sheet.Who: The man in the first photo, same blue T-shirt.
answer_sheet.Where: The rooftop in the second photo.
answer_sheet.Doing: Leaning on the white wall, taking a selfie.

must_haves: The man's face matches the attached photo (the dark beard, the short dark hair, the smile).
He wears the same blue T-shirt.
The setting matches the attached Santorini photo: white walls, blue domes, the windmill or the sea behind.
He holds a phone as if taking a selfie; the picture is square.
